notes.title: v1.5.0 is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]New contents[/h3]
[list]
[*] New special dungeon "Crystal beach"
[*] Added a mission to celebrate the series reaching 60 million corpses and BB2 reaching 400,000 registered users.
[/list]
[h3]New Function[/h3]
[list]
[*] New function "Skeltal adjustment"
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a setting to enable or disable displaying equipped lab parts on the Corpse Storage and Adventure Preparation screens.
[*] Changed the history function for the workshop and culture tank to register when creation begins.
[*] When defeated, the tip "To become stronger" is now displayed.
[*] Changed the UI behind the saving indicator so that it can be operated.
[*] Loadouts now retain easy mode selection
[*] Added an option to the Limb Storage Lab Parts selection screen to display parts from other setups that are already equipped
[*] The indicator display showing that the save is in progress has been changed to a larger size with text.
[*] Added history to the Factory and incubator
[/list]
[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted to make it less likely that users who have just started the game will encounter equipment with complex abilities.
[*] Change the default difficulty to easy mode
[*] The burst use flag for automatically used skills will now be turned off immediately after auto use.
[*] Changed so that the automatic used flag for each skill is reset every time you move to another room.
[*] Adjusted the performance of "Fighting Spirit"
[*] Adjusted the performance of "Incandescent"
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the error "TOWN-ADV-PREPARE-INFO.DETAIL" to occur when opening parameter details on the loadout screen.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Factory Help page would not open
[*] Fixed an issue where the crafting results were not reflected immediately when recreating a recipe from the workshop history.
[*] Fixed an issue where the names of races and jobs were not displayed correctly on the skeletal adjustment screen.
[*] Fixed some images.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[*] Fixed a bug where the error "MAIN-PICK-SKILL-DOPICK" would appear when trying to pick up a free skill.
[*] Fixed the error case "COMMON-EVENTSCENE-GONEXT".
[*] Fixed the error case "MAIN-ROOM-MOVE".
[*] Fixed an issue where runes that should not be able to be applied to free skills could be applied by using "Rune Preservation".
[*] Fixed a bug where when a burst skill was automatically used, the effect triggered by the burst skill use would not be activated until the end of the next turn.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to gain a shield even when having "overheal"
[*] Fixed an issue where some skills were extremely difficult to randomly drop
[*] Fixed a bug where help did not open on some screens
[*] Fix Discord invite link
[*] Fixed some error cases.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[*] Fixed some UI.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.1 is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]Important changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug in which purchase history data recorded on the game server was not reflected on the client when purchasing gold shards.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Set upper limits for each status value.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that some auto-triggering effects, such as "Auto: Initial" and "Auto: Move," were not continuously triggered.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the entire lineup could be purchased in Shop→Bargains.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented teleportation by origin "Escape" from working properly.
[*] Fixed the bug that Butcher's machete can not work properly.
[*] Fixed some error cases.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.1.0 is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638406/85f48e2afdfe84a635da0f8afbd3e12fc7012a93.jpg[/img]

[h3]Important changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] New union "Rabbit Transporter"
[*] Fixed a bug where saving might not complete properly in some environments.
[*] New feature "Limb Storage"
[*] Add 1000%+ risk status
[*] Added new abilities
[*] Addition of new shop item "Butcher's machete"
[*] New free inventory items added
[*] New base equipment "Bandit blade "Crossed lances", "Bone staff" and "Claw" added.
[*] Added alt mode to several existing skills
[*] Added new runes
[*] When the final resistance is negative, the HP stack has a certain probability of -1 every time damage of that attribute is taken.
[*] Now "Guts" can nullify HP stack reduction effects (up to 95% chance)
[*] Now Actions that grant "Bind" can not be parried.
[/list]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the shop menu "Others"
[*] [Android only] Added "Disable Back Button" setting to the settings screen.
[/list]

[h3]New contents[/h3]
[list]
[*] Addition of new elite and enemy-specific runes
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed app icons.
[*] Added "Bind" effect to reduce the probability of Parry
[*] Added a button to automate combat in the adventure menu
[*] Added help to display a list of abilities for equipment on the batch reroll screen.
[*] Added preview of skills possessed to the jail preparation screen.
[*] The "!!" icon on the menu button now disappears after viewing emergency information.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ability values of some lab parts were revised upward.
[*] Changed so that the treatment effect will no longer be accepted during the "immobility" effect.
[*] Changed "Punishment" to magical damage.
[*] Adjustment of lottery conditions for matching data for PvP dungeons
[*] Adjustment of some monsters' ability composition
[*] Adjustment of the amount of resistance gained from skills, runes, and corpse mod boards
[*] When "teleporting," one of the oldest dungeon statuses is deleted.
[*] When "Emerged" is given as a result of the "Chrysalis" effect, the skill mode is no longer switched.
[*] Changed to reset risk to 0% when reviving
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the image of the summoned minion would not be displayed when summoning a minion from auto recall.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the effect of crushing to be applied to the wrong target when the effect of "Crushing" was triggered from a state of self-damage, such as severe poisoning.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the jail help to open after opening the help link in the corpse limb vault.
[*] Fixed some text display.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused characters such as Common/Text to be displayed when language files were not loaded properly.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the combination of lab parts acquired at the Ominus was sometimes not applicable in rare cases.
[*] Fixed a bug that the transfer gold shard could not be reflected properly when the login to GameCenter was unstable.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some abilities from working properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the trigger effect of destroying an enemy in a specific state to be triggered multiple times.
[*] Fixed a bug where a single skill could be triggered multiple times in one turn due to a combination of autorunes.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused enemy HP to not be displayed correctly when repatriating an enemy.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause free skills to stun.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some screens from transitioning properly.
[*] Fixed some error cases.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.12 is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]Improvements
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the format of some asset data to be downloaded after the game is launched.
[*] Add display of dialog for store review requests in some environments
[*] When changing language settings, the default name of a character is now replaced by the default name of the target language.
[*] When changing language settings, all text on the screen is now immediately updated to the target language whenever possible.
[*] When opening a list of items such as bargains and quests for which you do not have the content, the list will now show that you do not have the content and an explanation of how to get it instead.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could prevent the HP stack display from updating properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the ability "Thief" from functioning properly.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.11 is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]Major changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add "Reroll History" function
[*] New missions added to each dungeon to obtain new item "Tag of Onslaught".
[*] Revision of the rarity calculation method for lab parts
[/list]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Reroll Confirmation Rarity" setting item.
[*] Add "Your Possession" list on the world map
[*] Added the ability to start a new adventure from the list of adventurers
[*] Added Buriedpedia in the adventure menu
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add the display of the damage elements that each skill has as dots
[*] When your skill is disabled, a dedicated display is added to the bottom of the skill selection column.
[*] Added the function to automatically restore from backup when character data is confirmed to be corrupted.
[*] Add a warning message when downloading a previous version of saved data from the Saved Data Manager, prompting the user to update the data.
[*] Searchable by keystone effect description on the keystone selection screen.
[*] Partially adjusted the order of inventory items
[*] Adjust the direction when a large amount of soulstones increase or decrease
[*] Copy function of whisper text
[*] Adjust the world map UI.
[*] Changed to open own temporary status screen even when moving
[*] Changed to skip combat effect processing in some cases, such as when an enemy's HP is already 0
[*] Added display of corresponding categories for each contract on the contract selection screen
[*] Clearly state "Target inversion not possible" in the skill description.
[*] Changed so that the event scene is not displayed when teleporting.
[*] Improved combat performance in some cases
[*] Now Searchable by Buriedpedia items.
[*] Added possession ability names as search terms to the Buriedpedia monster search.
[*] Brave changes from blue to yellow when bursting
[*] Adjusted line break position in skill description text.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Relaxed drop rarity range for keystones
[*] Minion death repatriation decisions are now also made at the end of the enemy turn
[*] Changed the ability "Thief".
[*] Adjusted specification of attribute absorption
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused an error when opening Buriedpedia in the battlefield.
[*] Fixed a bug that keystones in the set were not displayed in the "Possession List".
[*] Fixed a bug that the room list was not updated when entering a room with "Move to Next Floor" only.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the effect of "Pacifist" was also applied to soulstones acquired in various events.
[*] Fixed a bug that the drop rate from capturing may not increase as much as expected in some cases.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Rabbit Treasure Chest Repatriation Event that caused the log text to show "There were no items to repatriate" when only the treasure chest was repatriated without any inventory items in the possession of the user.
[*] Fixed a bug in which tags were displayed in skill descriptions and mission descriptions in some languages, preventing the original purpose from being confirmed.
[*] Fixed a bug that when the adventure menu was opened on the item acquisition screen, the adventure menu would re-open when the battle screen, etc. was opened afterwards.
[*] Fixed a bug where Union missions were not updated at the proper time unless the Union screen was opened, even if the Union mission update date and time were crossed.
[*] Fixed a bug that in rare cases, when opening detailed information, the screen would not close after pressing X.
[*] Fixed a bug where some Union Quests could become unresponsive to touch after prolonged play.
[*] Fixed a bug where shields, HP stacks, character visuals, etc. could be misrepresented as actual values when summoning and repatriating minions
[*] Fixed a bug that the "Now Loading" indicator would not disappear in rare cases when closing a camp.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the sorting of the list of monsters in the jail from working.
[*] Upper limit of ★ display by race x job changed to 35
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the list of occupations in Buriedpedia to change depending on the race selected in the adventure preparation.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused equipment of 6 or higher status crafted from inventory items to be created as 5 status.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the maximum order level to be sent to the union ranking instead of the cumulative total.
[*] Fixed demon death decisions (Fixed a bug that prevented demons from participating in PvP or prevented the "Crow's Skull" from working properly)
[*] Fixed a bug in which some screens did not operate according to key assignments.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented "Eternal Dark" from functioning properly.
[*] Fixed a rare UI error when using the mouse and keyboard together when selecting parts on the adventure results screen.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the effect description of a keystone was overlaid on its name in the keystone selection screen. (Truncated in long sentences)
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Craft" button did not match the actual number of recipes displayed in the list when you had duplicate craft recipes.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused inoperability when repeatedly hitting the Cancel button or corresponding key when closing the settings screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where a "Q" would appear on the skill list in burst mode when acquiring skill runes.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused keystone drops to be displayed in PvP dungeons.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause extra parameters to be added to some legendary equipments.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed the purchase of syndicate creation rights for non-syndicate-capable accounts.
[*] Fixed several cases that caused anomalous UI transitions when using the mouse and keyboard together.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some help links from working.
[*] Fixed some errors.
[*] Fixed some icons.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[*] Apply Translation Voluneer Texts.
[/list]

For more information, please check [url=https://trello.com/b/IWpnyWVJ/]the Update Schedule page[/url].

notes.title: v1.0.10 is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]Important[/h3]
[list]
[*] Distribution of ticket items for exchange
[*] (Re-)Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the display to be incorrect or prevented entry into certain rooms when repeatedly hitting the room to which the user was moving.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash when using close combat and pursuit damage together.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the game to crash if both you and your enemy had the infection.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Punishment from causing damage.
[/list]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added "Influence" button to the keystone column when preparing for an adventure
[*] Added "Exit Game" button at the bottom of the world map menu
[*] Added "Event scene message skip setting" to the settings screen
[*] The "Treasure Chest Count" dialog also displays the quantity of items that have been returned.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] When using WebView, changed to open the OS browser when navigating to a different domain than the opened URL.
[*] Changed acceleration during battle from x2 to x3
[*] Added trigger reason notation in the battle log for automatic use
[*] Added skill category display at the top of the name column on the skill details screen
[*] While displaying the text of an event scene, an up/down arrow icon is displayed at the bottom of the screen to indicate "press to advance".
[*] Apply Translation Volunteer texts.
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed ability "Torturer" → "Whenever you use a quick skill, removes all buffs from the enemy."
[*] Adjusted the effect of Blood Armor. → Changed from "Always avoid the Ailment Hit Decision" to "Reduce the effect value of the ailment infliction to 0".
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause infinite items such as medicinal herbs to drop from treasure chests during adventures.
[*] Fixed a bug where skills with the rune "Hold" on them would not return to default mode from alt mode.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the outer one does not receive void damage.
[*] Error "MAIN-ROOMS-USE" when using an inventory item that summons minions with Temptation and Minion enhancement abilities.
[*] Fixed a bug in which icons were not displayed on the whisper screen, etc., when some avatars, such as monsters, were selected on the player card.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the predicted HP did not decrease when persistent damage over time or delayed damage was inflicted.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the "Ignore Craft Consumption" popup from immediately appearing when performing crafts.
[*] Address issues with some items/skills/abilities/runes not working properly
[*] Fixed display of 100% skill boost in the final parameters screen when possessing "All-out".
[*] Fixed a bug where skill-derived passive effects were not displayed in the simplified display of important statuses.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused dog/demon, etc. to be minus the amount of parameters gained by equipping them.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused skills to be used automatically at level-up when the rune "Dancable" was equipped.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the damage inflicted to be zero if the power was too high.
[*] Fixed a bug where the description text displayed at the bottom of the screen during a rune exchange was out of date.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the effects of Fraurus and Amduskias to be reversed.
[*] Fixed some errors. (COMMON-EVENTSCENE-GONEXT, GU-EXDD-SELECT, MAIN-BATTLE-EFFECT, TOWN-UNION-SELECTED, COMMON-EVENTSCENE-GONEXT, MAIN-ROOMS-MOVED, MAIN-PICK-RUNE-SETVISUAL)
[*] Fixed an issue where enemy-specific runes that were not supposed to be available could drop.
[*] Fixed the issue where the target of the skill triggered by the "Auto: Stun" rune becomes oneself.
[*] Fixed a bug where the rune "Weak" was not working properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the same lab parts to reappear at the end of a PvP dungeon if the lab parts were discarded at the end of an adventure.
[*] Fixed a bug that initial soulstones, risk, etc. were not reflected at the start of the dungeon "Ominus".  (Keystone Purson, etc.)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the "Sniper" to have a 95% hit rate instead of 100%.
[*] Fixed a bug where "Wave Assault" could be triggered by the ability to automatically use some skills, such as "Shadow Clone".
[*] Fixed a bug in which some status time elapsed when Temptation was applied, such as when moving from one room to another.
[*] Fixed some UI.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.8 is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]New feature[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added option to select from black and white for icon blinking when rerolling
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some rune descriptions.
[*] Improved performance during adventures
[*] Added highlighting of more important states for display of parameters during battle (even permanent effects are listed as important)
[*] On the contract and keystone selection screen, default order changed to sort by ID instead of order of availability.
[*] Reduce the time required to display the global log at the bottom of the screen
[*] Adjusted the order of dungeon missions
[*] Changed sound effect of parry
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reset ranking
[*] Adjustment of enemy HP/HP stacks.
[*] Adjusted the number of times Ancient Shield can be used and consumed
[*] Changed the performance of Fairy Powder
[*] Adjusted overall minion parameters (Adjusted basic parameters downward and durability such as HP/shield upward)
[*] Adjusted the basic parameters of the Dancing Sword downward
[*] Added "Critical Multiplier Increase" effect to Werewolf.
[*] Monk Monk's passive "Calm As Water" was changed to "Willpower".
[*] Adjusted the performance of the free skill "Parry" downward.
[*] Reduce the amount of risk reduction when moving floors and instead increase the amount of risk reduction when using camps.
[*] The above change provides a route without camps on either side of the room on the floor where camps appear.
[*] Duration of the rune "Stalemate" changed to "/2 actions or 1 battle" and it can not be attached on the Free skill now.
[*] Added "Away" rune to "Phalanx" of minion "Dark Knight.
[*] Added "/1 room" to the time limit of the invincible effect obtained by the ability "Discipline".
[*] Changed so that camping always appears in all rooms on the 2nd floor only when playing the Highway for the first time.
[*] Items that can convert equipments to inventory items are now added to treasure chests instead of to inventory items in possession.
[*] Changed the performance of the dungeon status "Miasma" (as it was causing crashes)"
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the number of uses of acquired skills to be replenished even if the keystone "Aym" was applied.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the number of soulstones possessed to increase by double when it should have increased by +100 soulstones in the dungeon event in the “Slums”.
[*] Pirate: Changed to "Whenever Delayed Damage is applied to a target, you deal damage equal to 50% of the same Delayed Damage inflicted on the enemy."
[*] Ninja: Changed the effect target skill to "Random from those on cooldown".
[*] Caterpillar: Adjust mutation timing, Added "Reset all skills to default mode" immediately after transformation, Added "Emerged" removal when "Chrysalis" is used.
[*] Wave Assault: Changed to "Whenever you use a skill directly, Pursuit will be triggered once.
[*] Looming Threat: Changed so that skills and prison dungeons do not take effect when given to the player's side.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented rewards from being earned in some dungeon events.
[*] Limit download frequency from saved data management to every 30 minutes
[*] Adjustment of sub-dungeon appearance rate for each dungeon
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixing a bug that caused the effects of keystones to be applied to enemies.
[*] Fixed the bug that all monsters did not have Avoid Critical properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that in rare cases prevented moving to a room after a battle or sub-dungeon move.
[*] Fixed a crash on some iOS devices when opening the adventure result screen if the amount of reward is too large.
[*] Fix skills, abilities, and runes that are seen as not functioning properly
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented "Breakaway" from being executed while summoning minions
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some ★5 inventory items from dropping properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where trust was awarded to the current player's union instead of the character's union.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the display of craft costs and the determination of whether or not to implement a craft cost referred to the cost before the increase or decrease due to the ability.
[*] Fixed a bug that the Syndicate Ranking button was sometimes not displayed in each ranking, even if you are a member of a syndicate.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the description of the rune "Break (Weak/Strong)" and "Exhaust" was for a different rune.
[*] Fixed a bug where equipment crafting would replace equipment in your possession even if you selected "Ignore" after crafting the equipment.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused multiple contracts obtained multiple times to be displayed side by side on the selection screen.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some dungeon drop items to appear in multiple duplicates.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented quests that were completed once before from being added to the quest list when trying to accept them again in the same adventure.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause minions to be summoned just before an enemy died, depending on the timing of automatic use.
[*] Fixed a bug in which low rarity inventory items were not displayed correctly in Buriedpedia by dungeon.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed selection of incorrect lab parts to be applied.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the keystone used during an adventure to be changed.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the battle log from displaying properly in some languages.
[*] Fixed some abilities/skills/runes etc.
[*] Fixed a bug that syndicate rankings were not displayed properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented exchanging with the remaining skills when all other skills have been used 0 times.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused non-functional buttons to appear on some Buriedpedia screens, etc.
[*] Fixed a bug that in rare cases prevented users from moving rooms after using inventory items.
[*] Fixed a problem in which the cost of some contracts differed from the cost of the same crafted item in other contracts.
[*] Fixed a bug that the maximized window state sometimes did not work properly.
[*] Fixed some abilities/skills/runes etc.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the escape effect could be reversed by the rune "Invert".
[*] Fixed some errors.
[*] Fix some UI.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[*] Fixed the following elements that were not working properly:
[list]
[*] Human
[*] Giant
[*] Bard
[*] Vampire
[*] Ranged Strikes
[*] Energy Transfer
[*] Oblivion Gate
[*] Venomous Spider
[*] Spreading Spores
[*] Keystone "Naberius".
[*] Keystone "Astaroth"
[*] Keystone "Osé”/”Amy“
[*] Keystone "Barbados"
[*] Rarity-restricted systems such as the keystone "Vapura".
[*] Rune "Expel"
[*] Rune "Auto: Evade"
[*] Rune "Auto: Ail"
[*] Rune "Auto: Critical"
[*] Rune "Auto: Parry"
[*] Rune "Calm"
[*] Rune "Switcher"
[*] Rune "Lift"
[*] Spray of blood
[*] Summon Battle Maiden
[*] Mental Pollution
[*] Flesh Armor
[*] Dungeon status “Freezing”
[*] Skills triggered by "Parallel Thinking"
[*] Keystone "Agares"
[*] Keystone "Vine"
[*] Each Delayed damage
[*] Infection
[*] Immortality
[*] Noble
[*] Safe Return
[*] Schmeat
[*] Keystone "Zagan"
[*] Keystone "Batine".
[*] Keystone "Belial".
[*] Rune "Exhaust" and other various Remaining reduction effects
[*] Rune "Auto: Life"
[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.7 is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]New features[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638406/90443abba03fb0aea102d7de7fb6d6830c7653cc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] During battle, the "Breakaway" command appears instead of "Abandon".
[*] Distribution of gold shards as an apology
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] During a battle, you can now pause the battle by pressing the menu button even if you are disoriented or otherwise inoperable.
[*] UI fine-tuning
[*] Number held/ maximum number in the list of Graveyard
[*] Added save confirmation process when exiting adventurer and entering Graveyard
[*] Now you can see "Exit game" button in the config screen of all platforms.
[*] The Traveling troupe will be an online-only feature.
[*] When non-Japanese text is selected, the font spacing has been reverted to that of v1.0.6 and earlier.
[*] Improved UI for selection dialog
[*] Performance improvement of combat processing
[*] Functional adjustment to prevent some incorrect actions from being executed.
[*] Adjust button positions and tolerances in dialog
[*] Implemented countermeasures against fraudulent ranking data
[*] Added union names on the Graveyard.
[*] Added specific fonts for Russian
[/list]

[h3]Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjustment of appearance conditions for some elite types. + Adjusted HP to HP stack ratio for some elites.
[*] Adjusted boss monsters to prioritize the use of techniques other than their own when not in burst mode.
[*] Adjustment of the value set when some equipment is enhanced by crafting effects
[*] Changed the composition of skills used by low-ranked monsters
[*] Now, after reviving, all temporary conditions will be removed.
[*] Counter performance readjusted.
[*] Adjusting the performance of old boxes
[*] The minimum rarity of keystones that can be obtained when conquering deep areas has been set.
[*] Fixed ability values of some lab parts.
[*] Some items were changed to a type that disappears when used.
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced cases of game termination due to save failure.
[*] Fixed a bug that forced confirmation of room events immediately after teleportation, which could result in the replacement of equipment, skills, etc.
[*] Fixed a bug that some race rewards were not displayed in the dungeon's mission field (you can receive it in -v1.0.6).
[*] Fixed a bug that "Auto:Free" runes can be set for free skills (they will not work even if set).
[*] Fixed a bug that caused some temporary states that were terminated by the passage of a turn to remain at the end of the battle.
[*] Thereafter, the score record must be connected to the platform not only at the start of the adventure, but also at the end of the adventure.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the ability and skill columns sometimes remained on the screen when the character information screen was opened and closed in succession.
[*] Fixed a bug that purchase currency data could not be retrieved depending on network conditions.
[*] Fixed a rare bug that caused adventures to stop progressing because the room to which you were moving did not exist.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the same enemy to fight again only once after escaping from an event battle.
[*] Fixed a bug where selecting a syndicate whisper did not display details.
[*] Fixed a bug in which changes to brightness in the settings screen were not reflected.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented "Medication" effects from disappearing at the appropriate time.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some translation data from being applied properly.
[*] Fixed a bug that switching to Traditional Chinese was not always reflected.
[*] Fixed a bug in v1.0.7.4 that backup codes could not be used.
[*] Improved UI for Russian font
[*] Fixed some errors.
[*] Fixed bugs of some skills.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[/list]

In more detail, please read [url=https://trello.com/b/IWpnyWVJ]this page[/url].

notes.title: v1.0.6 is now available!
notes.content:
[h3][ Improvements ][/h3]
[list]
[*] UI-tuning
[*] Apply volunteer texts.
[*] Change frequency of platform auto saves to every minute
[*] Changed to restart the game immediately after an automatic restore from a cloud save.
[*] Improved some performance
[*] Increased game server upload limit to 2MB
[/list]

[h3][ Adjustments ][/h3]
[list]
[*] Downward adjustment of normal and state evasion rates for low-ranked monsters
[*] Adjusted so that "Auto: Turn" is not included in the runes owned by enemies such as elites.
[/list]

[h3][ Fixes ][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the save data file size would continue to grow if you continued playing for a long period of time, making the entire game heavy.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented adventures from starting in decisive battlegrounds and prisons if inventory items were insufficient when preparing for regular dungeons.
[*] Fixed some texts.
[*] Change of "Counter" and "Reflective Body" specification
[*] Fixed so that even if invisible half-width spaces are mixed in the backup code, they will be automatically removed.
[*] Adjusted the check timing to make save failure cases less likely to occur.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character information and skill list would remain open.
[*] Fixed some rare cases where the game would crash when starting
[*] Fixed a bug where only the same opponents appeared in PvP dungeons.
[*] Fixed a bug where some "Temptation" effects remained even after the battle ended.
[*] Fixed an issue where a "COMMON-SAVEFAILED" error would occur only once when starting the game with a new account.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player would freeze/crash in battle when possessing "Parallel Thinking"
[*] Corrected an issue where soulstones and mod points would not be awarded due to events under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed an issue where modification points could not be obtained from dungeon events when minions were present.
[*] Fixed an issue where players would not be able to progress if they entered a camp with a minion with "Deathrattle".
[*] Fixed a bug where the origin "Pacifist" was not displayed in the dungeon reward list (can be obtained by obtaining a score of 50000)
[*] Fixed an issue where the syndicate ID copy button was not displayed.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would crash when starting an adventure using the origin "Noble"
[*] Fixed a bug where the progress of missions/quests related to "encountering an event" was not progressing.
[*] Fixed "「MAIN-PICK-ITEM-REROLL!"/"MAIN-PICK-SKILL-REROLL!" error cases.
[*] Fixed "TOWN-ADV-PREPARE-ADVSTART"/"MAIN-ROOMS-MOVED" error case.
[*] Fixed "DUNGEON-RANKING-" error case.
[*] Fixed "COMMON-SAVEPLT!" error case.
[*] Fixed "INIT-BRANCH" error case.
[*] Fixed some errors. 
[/list]

Please read [url=https://trello.com/b/IWpnyWVJ/]this page[/url] for the detail.

notes.title: 今後のBuriedbornes2の運営計画について
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44638406/5a906b8f72f8063cc67be10d35fd4b6c4a8c1156.png[/img]

Thank you for playing Buriedbornes2. 
We deeply apologize to my players for the tremendous inconvenience caused by many problems.

I am currently working on resolving the critical issues as our top priority. 
I am making progress on each of the issues very smoothly, and I am grateful to my user community who are actively helping me find the cause of these issues. 
Thank you very much. 
There are still many issues to be addressed, and since this is a personal development project, it will inevitably take time to address them, but I will do my best to improve the title for the better. 

The following page summarizes my future management plans for Buriedbornes2. 
I will continue to update this page, and I hope that you will check back regularly.

[url=https://nussygame.com/en/bb2/management/]https://nussygame.com/en/bb2/management/[/url]

[h3]Update Info[/h3]
[b]2024/1/24[/b]
　We have released v1.0.7 and updated the schedule for future updates.

notes.title: v1.0.4 has been released.
notes.content:
[h1]Update Contents[/h1]
[h2]Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the adventure from progressing after the boss was defeated when escaping from a dungeon boss during a dungeon boss battle.
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes caused a MAIN-BATTLE-COMMONEND error at the end of a battle.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause a TOWN-LOADDATA error.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some Korean fonts from displaying properly.
[*] Fixed a bug where the error "MAIN-BATTLE-TURNSTART" or "MAIN-BATTLE-DOACT" would occur the moment the caterpillar emerged from the pupa.
[*] Fixed a rare "DONTDESTROYONLOAD-SAVEPLT!" error.
[*] Fixed a bug that URL does not open after selecting news
[/list]

[h1]Upcoming update plan[/h1]
For detailed update schedule, please check [url=https://nussygame.com/bb2/bb2_from240111/]this official website article[/url].

[h1]Future development policy[/h1]
[list]
[*] Our top priority will be to address issues that hinder play, such as saves and errors.
[*] After that, we will simultaneously improve the UI to make it easier to understand, ease the difficulty at the beginning, and fix minor issues.
[*] Once the major issues have been resolved, we will begin development for the first content update in parallel with the fixes.
[*] After v1.0.5 is released, we plan to add a bonus mission that allows all users to earn up to 1000 gold shards.
[/list]

We apologize for any inconvenience caused, and ask for your patience.
Please wait for a while until all the issues are resolved.
